card.name: Unit word right before "per" rates
card.fires_on: The counting or unit word just after a number when the next word is "per" or a slash, such as "cases" in "4 versus 3 cases per 10,000". Also "mg" before /kg or /mL.

modes.label: Cases per population
modes.description: The word cases or patients after a number, in incidence or absolute-risk comparisons before "per" a large count.
modes.example: The absolute risk for CE plus MPA versus placebo was 4 versus 3<< cases>> per 10,000

modes.description: The unit mg after a number when a slash and another unit follow.
